subject: Proposal from coder
body:
slice-7 signal-calibration fixes (§2 "stop crying wolf"), tasks 7-1..7-4, commit d38ce7f35. Four false-alarm vectors fixed, each with a co-located corpus detector that strict-passes the slice-1 overseer-calibration rows (registered by the slice-7 test):

• task-7-1 (phase_output.py, context.py): add PipelineHealthContext.awaiting_spawn; gate PhaseOutputPresenceCheck so a producer drafting under orchestrator-owned spawn (lifecycle_owner=orchestrator + awaiting_spawn) is HEALTHY, not a DEGRADED zero-commit stall (#3230).

• task-7-2 (midturn_messages.py, client.py): mid-turn injection gates on message INTENT, not from_role. classify_message_intent + split _render_block render informational overseer/orchestrator OVERSEER_ALERTs NON-binding, while operator directives AND the #3123 brc_confirmation_timeout nudge (metadata.alert_type) stay BINDING. New detect_alert_reflection.

• task-7-3 (pipelines.py): replaced _BRANCH_DIVERGENCE_PR_RE "(#NNNN)" subject regex with a patch-id signal (contamination = ahead-commit whose patch-id matches a base-merged commit); capped scan window. New detect_branch_divergence keys on git_state ancestor/patch-id (#2222/#2224).

• task-7-4 (consensus_stall.py, classifier.py): detect_heartbeat_stall keys on tool-call recency so a busy agent (tool calls every 2-3s) is never flagged (#2242). Added first-class ActivityPattern verdicts + classify_activity_pattern, closed/coerced vocabulary (#2059/#2132).

Detectors delivered as importable callables for the tester to register via register_detector; production-plane wiring is slice-8 scope.
